author: Flebula
body:
Now before you read this, do not think this is going to be another one of them spam posts about the issues on Avicus, I am trying to get them posts to stop now.

So I have looked at about 15 discussions saying Avicus is going to drop to zero players sooner or later. SpicyTunaRoll9 left because of that. The server will not die for a long, long time. For many reasons.
1. The server has so many regular users and fans of Avicus that the numbers will not get to zero. I will not be leaving Avicus for years and some other people might have the same plans as me. I am 12 so I have plenty of time to spend on Avicus.

2. The gamemodes are too known to be abandoned. Face it, it is not like in a couple of months it is just going to be like Nebula never existed. The Walls and Nebula have dug so far into Minecraft online history that people will almost always want to play it every now and then.

3. The staff are to great. After all the great times of helping people and dedicating themselves for months, just to get an update out, that they are just going to give up? Even if the numbers got to zero our moderators would be working to get their numbers back up again, just like when the server started. They would dedicate themselves to a extent where it would be irresistible not to join. Besides the numbers aren't going to get to zero anyway.

4. The plans. The moderators have future plans for Avicus that we will have to wait for, they will probably add new game modes, fix the lag and once they get game modes and fix the lag, that will get more players = more money to employ Developers. Have a think about this guys. This is a sentence by the known moderator Cupcake1241 "We shouldn't shut down anytime soon because the staff team have so much planned, trust me. It may look dim now however the future should reveal the light."

What we can do to help: 

1. Donate. Donating gives money to the server so they can employ more developers. If you didn't know developers fix the issues and make up the games and maps. They fix all bugs and make sure the hubs aren't down. Also don't blame the issues on IvyCode (Only developer) He is trying his best to maintain Avicus and school work so you need to show respect for the effort he is putting in.

2. Voting. I'm not exactly sure what voting actually does, but if you are looking for more players, that always helps :D

3. Make more videos on YouTube.We haven't truly hit a spark with a successful YouTuber who constantly advertises Avicus since legosean10. He is gone now so lets get another YouTuber who can get lots of subs and promote Avicus! It is easy, just get a free scree recorder like Bandicam, and work your way up :D

4. Try and make posts on FaceBook, Twitter, Instagram and more that promotes Avicus. Say something like these are my favourite game modes, come and play with me on this IP: avicu.us then, put a link to a video and that probably adds another player right there! Just make sure you are not advertising on other servers like constantly spamming the chat saying " JOIN AVICUS WITH GREAT GAME MODES!!!" not only will that get you banned, you will get Avicus a bad reputation.

Other notes:
Stop saying "Avicus sucks because it isn't Mczone!!" Please try and remember Mczone was at a declining state and that is one of the reasons we updated.

Thanks you all the staff! I hope this post reduced all the posts nagging you about Avicus dying!

replies.author: Gforce40
replies.body:
There are so many flaws in your argument.
First of all, even the regulars can get bored of the same stuff over and over. I would've considered myself a regular a few months ago but it just got pointless. Also the same crap, crap maps, server kicks you out often (Might just be me idk), kill farming, annoying people and hackers.
Second, you talked about how the gamemodes are too well known to be left. If someone wanted to play walls, avicus isn't really the place to do it. You would play it on a much more active server, whose gamemodes are much more diverse. Nebula, however, I agree with you on. It is the only thing holding avicus up but people will get bored with it unless people start making more GOOD maps.
You talked about how good the staff are, but the head of this entire server doesn't even care about it anymore. When's the last time you heard from FunkyCode let alone seen him in-game playing it.
Last, I would love to believe it, but it just doesn't sound true. If I'm wrong you can sit me in front of everyone and laugh but I just don't believe it. Also, whatever it is probably won't spark that much of interest. Look at avicore, the mods hyped it up like it was some revolutionary thing but, almost nothing changed. We got nexus and avicade BACK, they weren't even new. We also got some new maps that were terrible anyway.I'm sorry to see this server go but it's definitely happening.
